## Standing operator rules
Never modify the license text or attribution section in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md by hand.

Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

Heads up: The staging database moved to db-stg-2.internal last week. db-stg-1 is a decommissioned read-only replica; config/staging.yaml is stale. Always use db-stg-2.

Always post the rendered release notes in #ledgerly-releases using the `ledgerly-release-notes-v3` template before starting the staging smoke test.

## Current objective
Finish and verify invoice-summary query optimization. Webhook verification work is paused; pagination reached step 3.

## Ruled-out approaches
Per-invoice embedding was too slow. 100-document batches broke request-count assumptions. Tenant-less scanning was slow. Per-vector transactions and per-invocation embedding clients were inefficient/unnecessary. A five-attempt webhook retry decorator resent customer emails.

## Recent work
Added invoice pagination with bounded `limit`/`offset`, count totals, response envelopes, and tests; 18 billing tests passed. Profiling found invoice-summary N+1 queries: 2,431 statements and 37.9 seconds. Moved filtering and `Sum("amount")` aggregation outside the currency loop, reducing this to one query per account. Re-run profiling, report tests, formatting, and diff checks, then commit separately.

Operator: Never modify the license text or attribution section in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md by hand.
Operator: Goal for this session: add pagination to the GET /v1/invoices endpoint in ledgerly/api/invoices.py.
Operator: separate from the main session goal, please also run the procedure 'split-order-rules-package' in between your other work. Goal: Move order rules from the monolith into a public package and update imports in six services safely. Run these steps in order, one at a time:
1. Inspect legacy module: `git status --short && sed -n '1,40p' src/order_rules.py && grep -R "order_rules" -n services --include='*.py'`
2. Create package directory: `mkdir -p packages/order_core && cp src/order_rules.py packages/order_core/rules.py`
3. Add public package API: `printf '%s\n' 'from .rules import calculate_total' '' "__all__ = ['calculate_total']" > packages/order_core/__init__.py`
4. Update six service imports: `grep -rl 'from order_rules import' services/{checkout,billing,inventory,shipping,notifications,reporting} --include='*.py' | xargs sed -i 's/from order_rules import/from order_core import/g'`
5. Remove legacy module: `rm src/order_rules.py`
6. Compile changed Python: `python3 -m compileall -q packages/order_core services/checkout services/billing services/inventory`
7. Run focused tests: `pytest -q tests/order_rules tests/checkout/test_totals.py tests/billing/test_invoices.py`
8. Review final diff: `git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat`
